violations.statement: Arin still remembers the whole night walk at dawn on Day 3.
violations.rationale: Arin carried the chord stone all night (S07) yet remembers the whole walk; under this rule he should have lost his last hour.

violations.statement: Teodor briefly presses the chord stone to Arin's hand so he forgets the night.
violations.rationale: A brief touch is under ten minutes, so under this rule it would not erase Arin's memory as S10 intends.
